bugs.creator: michaelchirico4
bugs.summary: Inconsistency in .pot files for R vs src translations

comments.text:
`tools::xgettext2pot()` doesn't have any restrictions with respect to line width, whereas `tools::update_pkg_po()` runs command-line `xgettext` for C/C++ files, which defaults to setting `--width=79`, resulting in the following inconsistency:

```
max(nchar(readLines("src/library/base/po/R.pot")))
# [1] 79
max(nchar(readLines("src/library/base/po/R-base.pot")))
# [1] 133
```

A trivial fix is to provide `--no-wrap` to the `xgettext` cmd in `tools::update_pkg_po()` here:

https://github.com/wch/r-source/blob/da944f2022f60c11c4d70f5320ef18163b0a10cc/src/library/tools/R/translations.R#L180-L188

To achieve consistency the other way is slightly more involved, basically an edit to do add `strwrap()`-ish behavior here, probably with a helper function:

https://github.com/wch/r-source/blob/da944f2022f60c11c4d70f5320ef18163b0a10cc/src/library/tools/R/xgettext.R#L181-L182

I am happy to provide either patch. Just tell me (1) that this inconsistency is worth fixing and (2) which approach is preferred.
comments.creator: michaelchirico4
michaelchirico4
comments.text:
By the way, no default `--width` is mentioned in the manual for `xgettext`:

https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/manual/html_node/xgettext-Invocation.html

One must instead trawl through the sources a bit to find `gettext/gettext-tools/write-catalog.c` mentioning the default is the `PAGE_WIDTH` defined in `gettext/gettext-tools/configure.ac`:

https://git.savannah.gnu.org/gitweb/?p=gettext.git;a=blob;f=gettext-tools/src/write-catalog.c;h=c25916d1b403dc57257b85771c256bf833448f58;hb=HEAD#l72

https://git.savannah.gnu.org/gitweb/?p=gettext.git;a=blob;f=gettext-tools/configure.ac;h=63a0b1ee56f9acd04643d03c51ba37b9c35caa88;hb=HEAD#l327

comments.text:
Noting two more inconsistencies between what `xgettext` makes for the .pot file and what `tools::xgettext2pot()` does:

The top `msgid ""` lines don't match. The R file is missing the `Language` and `Plural-Forms` entries:

```
# * FROM src/library/base/po/R.pot *
msgid ""
msgstr ""
"Project-Id-Version: R 4.2.0\n"
"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: bugs.r-project.org\n"
"POT-Creation-Date: 2021-05-03 09:56+0200\n"
"PO-Revision-Date: YEAR-MO-DA HO:MI+ZONE\n"
"Last-Translator: FULL NAME <EMAIL@ADDRESS>\n"
"Language-Team: LANGUAGE <LL@li.org>\n"
"Language: \n"
"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=CHARSET\n"
"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
"Plural-Forms: nplurals=INTEGER; plural=EXPRESSION;\n"
```

```
# * FROM src/library/base/po/R-base.pot
msgid ""
msgstr ""
"Project-Id-Version: R 4.2.0\n"
"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: bugs.r-project.org\n"
"POT-Creation-Date: 2021-05-03 09:56\n"
"PO-Revision-Date: YEAR-MO-DA HO:MI+ZONE\n"
"Last-Translator: FULL NAME <EMAIL@ADDRESS>\n"
"Language-Team: LANGUAGE <LL@li.org>\n"
"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=CHARSET\n"
"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
```

The `xgettext` output also adds some template note comment at the top, and marks the `msgid ""` message as fuzzy:

```
# * first 6 lines of src/library/base/po/R.pot *
# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
# Copyright (C) YEAR The R Core Team
# This file is distributed under the same license as the R package.
# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, YEAR.
#
#, fuzzy
```

 - `Language: ` is always written by `xgettext`; it would be easy to add this to `tools::xgettext2pot()`
 - `Plural-Forms: ` is only written if there are plural messages. So `src/library/base/po/R.pot` has it, but none of the others do (e.g. `src/library/stats/po/stats.pot`). It would be straightforward to account for this & add it to `tools::xgettext2pot()`
 - The "template note" is governed by the `--copyright-holder` argument: https://git.savannah.gnu.org/gitweb/?p=gettext.git;a=blob;f=gettext-tools/src/xgettext.c;h=e9fb4a0abcca2fd34691c7d82358dc15156ca165;hb=HEAD#l2034. `tools::update_pkg_po()` accepts a `copyright` argument but `tools::xgettext2pot()` doesn't use it. The easiest fix here -- update the signature of `tools::xgettext2pot()` to accept `copyright`, then manually fill in the same strings to match the `xgettext` behavior -- is somewhat fragile (relies on `xgettext` not changing the underlying strings). FWIW if I'm reading the blame correctly, the `copyright=NULL` case hasn't changed since 2001, while the `copyright` template was updated in 2015.

As always I am happy to file a patch if R-core is interested.

A related inconsistency: xgettext _always_ wraps at newlines (even if the message fits within `--width`).

See e.g. https://github.com/wch/r-source/blob/d790a9dee4c82d8249df209c6b8da7070f0737fa/src/library/grDevices/po/grDevices.pot#L341-L346 as compared to https://github.com/wch/r-source/blob/d790a9dee4c82d8249df209c6b8da7070f0737fa/src/library/utils/po/R-utils.pot#L14-L15:

```
#: devPS.c:3771 devPS.c:3786
#, c-format
msgid ""
"error from postscript() in running:\n"
"    %s"
msgstr ""
```

vs

```
msgid "RShowDoc() should be used with a character string argument specifying\n   a documentation file"
msgstr ""
```

comments.text:
Another trivial difference that nonetheless would be easy to fix alongside anything else in this report:

`tools::xgettext2pot()` writes an extra blank line between the metadata and main `msgid` in the `R-*.pot` files, e.g. c.f. https://github.com/wch/r-source/blob/d790a9dee4c82d8249df209c6b8da7070f0737fa/src/library/utils/po/R-utils.pot#L12 vs. https://github.com/wch/r-source/blob/d790a9dee4c82d8249df209c6b8da7070f0737fa/src/library/utils/po/utils.pot#L19

A trivial fix is to eliminate the last element of the metadata written in `tools::xgettext2pot()`:

https://github.com/wch/r-source/blob/d790a9dee4c82d8249df209c6b8da7070f0737fa/src/library/tools/R/xgettext.R#L180

because each `msgid`/`msgstr` entry is already preceded by a blank just below:

https://github.com/wch/r-source/blob/d790a9dee4c82d8249df209c6b8da7070f0737fa/src/library/tools/R/xgettext.R#L182
